verdict.rationale: Devin is itself the built-in AI assistant. The docs describe delegating work to it from several places: the web app with IDE takeover, the terminal CLI with /handoff to cloud Devin, Slack/Teams tagging, parallel sessions, and API-created sessions. Community comments question how good the output is (e.g. 13.8% of issues resolved) but do not contradict that delegation works as documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of successful delegated tasks.
